correctness.rationale: The proof reconstructs the full projective automorphism group from the Hessian triangle, reduces every point stabilizer to the permutation stabilizer of the projective cube triple, excludes all transposition stabilizers by the exact source polynomial value \(q(1)=-243\), identifies the only possible three-cycle-fixed cube triples, and counts their 18 projective cube roots. The remaining 54 points have trivial stabilizer and therefore form one orbit. The exact symbolic replay verifies the polynomial identities and finite stabilizer arithmetic.

value.rationale: The 72 type-9 points are the central finite configuration of the initiating paper. Determining their full projective orbit structure is a natural invariant, and the exceptional 18-point orbit gives a structural explanation for the rational sextic factor in the published degree-24 equation. The result is not a coordinate renaming or isolated numerical recomputation: it gives a complete stabilizer classification and a low-degree intrinsic equation for the symmetry-enhanced stratum.
